title: Preparing Your Documents for AI-Assisted Work: A Practical Tidy-Up Checklist

cards.heading: Check every file is readable
cards.text: Scans should be straight, sharp and complete. If you struggle to read a page, flag it.

cards.heading: Name files so people can tell them apart
cards.text: A date, a document type and a short description is enough.

cards.heading: Keep only the current version
cards.text: Remove duplicates and label anything superseded, so nobody works from an old draft.

cards.heading: Check for sensitive content first
cards.text: Decide what should be shared at all, and raise confidential material with your supplier early.

cards.heading: Add a short covering note
cards.text: Say what the batch contains, what you want done and anything you know is odd.

facebook.message:
Are your documents in a fit state to hand over for AI-assisted work?
Blurred scans, missing pages and three versions of the same policy all make the result worse, however clear the task. Our new guide covers a short tidy-up:
• Make sure every page is readable and present
• Name files and keep only the current version
• Check for sensitive material before anything is shared
Swipe through for the key points.

To read the full article, visit the FinTaxTech website and find "Preparing Your Documents for AI-Assisted Work: A Practical Tidy-Up Checklist" in our Blog section.
